text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: alert — inference-prod-us-west pending queue > 1200 (2m). autoscaler attempted scale up but nodes not provisioning.
oncall-olivia: I'm on it, joining bridge now — will check node pool constraints.
incident-bot: Pager sent to @oncall-olivia (P1). Bridge: https://meet.example/bridge/1745001234
infra-miguel: seeing quota errors from cloud: 'COMPUTE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED' in project-redwood-prod. gke-gpu-pool-3 failing to create n1-preemptible-gpu instances.
oncall-olivia: copy. Miguel, can you confirm which quota (GPUs or vCPUs)?
infra-miguel: GPUs (NVIDIA A100) quota at 0 in us-west1. We had scheduled scale in earlier and earlier quota reclamation completed yesterday.
sre-lee: adding context: autoscaler logs show repeated 403/429 throttles when calling cloud API. Some requests are rate-limited + quota denied.
oncall-olivia: temporary mitigation? Can we re-route traffic to eu-west while we fix provisioning?
eng-platform-raj: We can enable regional routing to eu-west low-latency pool for non-pinned tenants, but it'll take ~90s for route propagation. Rolling fallback config: `route_policy: prefer-region:us-west fallback: eu-west` — we can flip to force-fallback.
oncall-olivia: do it. Raj, flip now and announce.
eng-platform-raj: flipped routing flag, propagation started. Confirming: some customers will experience ~200ms extra latency.
cust-success-amy: Heads-up to CS: I’ll draft a short note for affected enterprise customers explaining temporary region shift. No PII affected.
oncall-olivia: Meanwhile infra, can we request quota emergency increase? Miguel, submit support ticket and escalate.
infra-miguel: ticket #SUP-87921 opened with cloud support — reference: quota emergency for A100 GPUs in us-west1. Submitted at 1745001400.
sre-lee: Actionable runbook items from bridge: 1) force routing fallback (done) 2) open quota ticket (done) 3) spin up backup bare-metal nodes if quota delayed — Miguel to greenlight.
infra-miguel: I can trigger bare-metal pool bootstrap. Will start provisioning nodes from dedicated pool (non-cloud) — ETA 18m.
oncall-olivia: Noted. I'll stay on bridge until load normalizes. Raj, monitor routing metrics and let me know when queue < 200.
eng-platform-raj: queue fell to ~400 after routing flip. Still draining.
sre-lee: Logging that customer impact window: 1745001234 - 1745003300 (partial degrade, higher latency and some rate-limited requests).
cust-success-amy: Draft sent to CS channel, tagging affected accounts. Will wait for final confirmation before sending customer-facing email.
infra-miguel: bare-metal pool started; first nodes joined at 1745002800. capacity +200 concurrent inference workers.
oncall-olivia: queue now <180. Starting to wind down bridge in 10m.
ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (routing fallback + backup pool) at 1745003000. Monitoring for regressions.
sre-lee: Post-incident next steps: 1) schedule a 30m postmortem (prefer async doc + 1 sync) 2) action item: evaluate quota automation and predictive buffer 3) add guardrail to prevent scheduled scale-in from setting GPU quota to 0.
oncall-olivia: I'm available for postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT. Miguel, Raj, Lee please confirm.
infra-miguel: confirm.
eng-platform-raj: confirm.
sre-lee: confirm.
cust-success-amy: I'll attend briefly to align customer comms.
oncall-olivia: Creating follow-up board and Jira tasks now. Quick list: JIRA-INC-4567 (quota-automation), JIRA-INC-4568 (scalein-guardrail), JIRA-INC-4569 (fallback-test-playbook). I'll ping when tickets created.
ops-bot: Reminder set: postmortem doc due in 48h. Owner: oncall-olivia.
noncall-olivia: Closing thread here; move follow-ups to #postmortems and JIRA. Thanks for quick responses :thumbsup:
